$comment: Disposition registry for test-book-e2e.md cases. testbook-coverage.test.mjs checks that every case has exactly one disposition and that the file named in the book's executable column exists. It does not check that a test in that file implements the case, so each row's scenario stays a claim a reviewer must verify. `owners` name the suite responsible for each case. `exclusions` need a written reason of at least 40 characters and fail the gate if the case is also owned. `ratchet.maxUnassigned` may only be lowered.

exclusions.reason: Real /chunk from a saved /parse JSON at maximum document size requires a live stack and a large real corpus; deterministic packing is proven offline by the backend suite and live repair coverage is rag-repair-live.

Real S3 lifecycle/retention expiry cannot be observed inside a single test run without waiting for bucket expiration; it is an operator verification through verify_storage_live and SeaweedFS config, not a browser case.
MCP-live agent workflow requires a running smart-document-mcp server and a real MCP client; it is executed by scripts/verify_mcp_live.py as operator evidence, not by the Playwright suite.
Skill-agent workflow requires a real agent host loading the ocr-skill SKILL.md; prompt-side behaviour cannot be asserted by Playwright and is validated by the skill contract tests only.
Skill-agent JSON-interpretation workflow requires a real agent host; the smart-document-reader skill rules are enforced by tests/test_smart_document_reader_skill.py, not by browser evidence.

Live stack smoke verification (verify_api_live, verify_rag_smoke, verify_storage_live) is an operator/API-live campaign against a running stack, not a default mock/browser case; evidence is recorded per run.
Live autotune profile proof (verify_autotune_live) requires a completed startup calibration on real GPU hardware and is recorded as operator evidence, never mocked.
